title: Prove or refute the singular-boundary Schur inequality
objective: Prove or refute lambda_min(S_C)>=2 for every singular unit-diagonal PSD correlation matrix C, equivalently E||M_pi(C)^(-1)z||^2 >= 2||P_ker(C)z||^2 for every z, using the reverse-closed triangular-solve family and respecting the Schur coupling to range(C).
acceptance_checks: Uses the full Schur complement S_C rather than only the kernel compression of K_0.
Handles arbitrary nullity and arbitrary elliptope rank.
Checks the two-pole/ring family and the signed rank-one boundary as sharpness tests.
A counterexample must be exact or interval-certified and lifted to sufficiently small positive mu.

resolution.scope: T080 and the sharp strong one-epoch A-energy certificate are refuted; C001 remains open.
